english.notes:
(i) A person does not commit the offence if the person took all reasonable steps to comply with the notice, or there is some other reasonable excuse for the failure to comply with it.
(ii) This offence is eligible for a Fixed Penalty Notice (under section 52 of the Act). Such a notice may be issued by a constable (and a suitably designated PCSO) as well as the local authority.
(iii) A fixed penalty issued for this offence is payable to the local authority and should not be processed using the PentiP system.
